data.accessory_abyssal_compendium_description: A book listing forgotten techniques of spellweaving, learned from eldritch entities at a great price.
data.accessory_amulet_of_resurrection_descrip: Made from the feathers of a legendary bird, in case of death this amulet will resurrect its owner with full HP and no negative effect, possibly forever.
data.accessory_amulet_of_the_swordsman_descri: An amulet that allows the wearer to see through it as if it was an additional eye. Gives a new perspective on the fight, allowing for superior decision making.
data.accessory_ancient_boots_description: Boots sewn together using the resistant and flexible hide of prehistoric giants.
data.accessory_ancient_eye_description: A gift from a nameless horror.
data.accessory_ancient_gloves_description: Gloves sewn together using the resistant and flexible hide of prehistoric giants.
data.accessory_animated_bucker_description: Round shield made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.
data.accessory_animated_helm_description: Helm made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.
data.accessory_archaic_amulet_description: A fiery gem embedded in this pendant attracts wildlife, enhancing the holder\'s empathy and connection with animals they\'re close with. Grants Animal Affinity, which increases the damage of living creatures controlled by 1% for each point.
data.accessory_archmage_hat_description: Extremely powerful, magic-enhancing artifact worn only by Laroxian\'s Council members.
data.accessory_banshee_gloves_description: Made from Banshee scales grafted together. Allows for superior protection while granting a great range of movements.
data.accessory_black_iron_gauntlets_descripti: Gauntlets made of disjointed plates of Black Iron.
data.accessory_black_iron_helm_description: Resistant helm made with Black Iron.
data.accessory_bleak_boots_description: Boots made from unknown materials, glowing with an evil light and blessed by an ancient power.
data.accessory_bleak_gloves_description: Gloves made from unknown materials, glowing with an evil light and blessed by an ancient power.
data.accessory_burning_censer_description: An otherworldly candle encased in a metal support, anointed with oils that display healing properties.
data.accessory_burning_effigy_description: A powerful symbol of hope for those it protects, and a relentless torment for its bearer. It compels enemies to focus their attention on the holder, who endures the crushing burden of infinite, searing agony.
data.accessory_celestial_helmet_description: Helmet crafted from a metal not from this world. Offers higher standards of protection than any alloy made from ordinary metals.
data.accessory_celestial_shield_description: Shield crafted from a metal not from this world. Offers higher standards of protection than any alloy made from ordinary metals.
data.accessory_copper_helmet_description: Regular helmet made with copper for some extra protection.
data.accessory_corrupted_shield_description: The integrity of this shield has been severely impaired by the curse of the Serpent.
data.accessory_cosmic_violin_description: A violin as old as time itself, played by ancient horrors during their abject rituals.
data.accessory_cursed_claws_description: Forged from a metal worn by undead beings for unfathomable time, will open a grievous wound on an enemy with the slightest touch. The attack has to be melee for this to happen.\nBLEED: the target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge
data.accessory_cursed_helm_description: Forged from a metal worn by undead beings for unfathomable time, its sharp edges deter any melee attacker, promising devastating wounds to those who dare approach.
data.accessory_diamond_amulet_description: An elegant amulet adorned with a polished diamond, radiating timeless beauty.
data.accessory_divine_embryo_description: Painstakingly fed with a concentrated flow of consciousness, slowly the Ancient God is starting to evolve into another form. It is able to manifest additional powers, granting its keeper a wide range of bonuses.
data.accessory_divine_larvae_description: Fed with the flesh of a nightmare beyond comprehension, the new shell of the Hidden God transformed once more, inching closer to its final form.
data.accessory_divine_zygote_description: The remains of a being of endless power, who used their last drop of energy to restore its own mortal body into an earlier form. Unable to survive alone, it emanates an energy barrier of unfathomable strength, protecting itself and its keeper from the outside elements.
